description: MVP of a data-collection layer that stores only what a camera+IMU rig cannot predict (corollary-discharge cancellation + residual triggering), inspired by Perks et al., Nature 2026 (doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10690-6).

datasets.description: Rendered rig: static textured scene + gyro-driven camera rotation + injected blob/bar surprise events. The primary benchmark (train/val splits, frames + imu.csv + events.json + featmaps.npy per sequence).
60-second single-scene demo used by the pixel-pipeline experiment (scripts/run_experiment.py).
Webcam field test: real camera, synthetic scene motion, no IMU (sines emulated offline). Used for the webcam readout in README.

Raw Open-AoE segment source (ant-research OpenAoE-2000h via hf-mirror): camera_traj.npz (SLAM cam_c2w), ego_action_annotation.json, undistorted mp4. 9 segments fetched by scripts/fetch_aoe.py (probe 60 -> greedy scene/verb select -> fetch): aoe_20260214_232847_p000 (kitchen/unboxing) + 8 raw_*_seg_* (bathroom, bedroom, childs-room, dining/kitchen/living, workshop, workspace, shop; 134-301 s each).

Open-AoE segments converted to the standard sequence layout by scripts/prep_aoe.py: gyro derived from trajectory differentiation (sign auto-calibrated vs DIS flow), per-segment real f_map (10.95-19.17), events = active-manipulation intervals. val/seq_000..seq_008, 67.4k frames total.

results.note: last run: data/aoe --n-val 9 --robust (Open-AoE 9 segments, winsorized stats). Earlier synthetic-rig numbers are in the README tables and are overwritten by the most recent run.
results.headline: AoE robust n=9: gyro clips stored 1.2-13.1% (median 9.2%), evRec 0.14-0.79 (median 0.46); gated stats (naive/flow) fire ~zero clips except seq_004 flow hallucination (stored 0.99); gyro-warp calm residual ~= naive everywhere (sub-pixel ego-motion). Latency: DIS 8.3ms, flow step 6.6ms, gyro shift 0.073ms, pixel core 0.199ms, backbone 1.078ms per frame.

results.note: synthetic rig, logistic head on frozen featmaps, clip-based training
results.headline: cerebellum clips: 3.4% stored, val AP 0.298, evRec@10 0.96 — beats uniform at 4x bytes (51% stored, AP 0.145) and beats oracle-adaptive on event recall. MLP head: measured negative (in README).

results.note: last run: data/aoe --n-val 9 --robust. Synthetic-rig run: 6/118 val runs vetoed, stored 0.520->0.498, precision 0.146->0.155, evRec 1.0, amortized ~0.15 ms/frame.
